target.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command
target.body:
## Summary

Adds `codexbar cookie refresh --provider <name>` CLI command to force re-import of browser cookies for cookie-authenticated providers.

**Note:** Settings-pane refresh buttons (↻) split into a separate PR: **#2264**.

## Behaviour

- `codexbar cookie refresh --provider opencodego` — clears Keychain cache, re-imports from all supported browsers, stores fresh cookie
- `codexbar cookie refresh --all` — refreshes OpenCode and OpenCode Go
- Falls back gracefully when `importSession` fails (code-signing entitlements required)
- Supports `--format text|json`, `--json`, `--json-only`, `--pretty`
- Uses the provider's automatic browser import order (scans all installed browsers via `preferredBrowsers: []`)

## Verified Behaviour

### Evidence

See `docs/proof/cli-cookie-refresh-proof.md` for full test matrix.

Key results:

| Test | Result |
|------|--------|
| `cookie refresh --provider opencodego` | ✅ JSON output: `"status": "cleared"` |
| Before: Keychain `cookie.opencodego` | `storedAt: 2026-07-17T18:25:50Z` |
| After: Keychain lookup | ❌ Not found (cache cleared) |
| After CodexBar.app refresh | ✅ Cookie re-imported with fresh `storedAt` |
| `--provider nonexistent` | ✅ `"Unknown provider: nonexistent"` |
| `--all` | ✅ Targets only OpenCode + OpenCodeGo |
| `--format json --pretty` | ✅ Valid JSON output |
| Build | ✅ `swift build` zero errors |

### End-to-end flow

```
CLI command                         CodexBar.app (menu bar)
┌──────────────────────┐            ┌─────────────────────┐
│ cookie refresh       │            │ auto-refresh detects │
│ --provider opencodego│            │ missing cache        │
│                      │            │                      │
│ ① Clear Keychain ✅  │  ──────→  │ ② SweetCookieKit     │
│ ② Import browser ❌  │  (fail)   │    import from Chrome │
│    (unsigned binary) │            │ ③ Store in Keychain  │
│ ③ Print "cleared"    │            │ ④ Refresh usage ✅   │
└──────────────────────┘            └─────────────────────┘
```

### Known Limitation

`OpenCodeCookieImporter.importSession()` requires code-signing entitlements unavailable in debug CLI builds. The command clears the cache and falls back — the actual re-import happens when CodexBar.app (with proper entitlements) refreshes. Same behaviour as `codexbar cache clear --cookies` which also clears without importing.

## Related

- Issue: https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/2260
- Settings PR: https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2264

target.title: Migrate CookieHeaderCache test overrides to task-local scopes
target.body:
## Summary
Migrate `CookieHeaderCache`'s legacyBaseURL and display-interval (staleness / unavailable-retry) test
overrides off their process-global `nonisolated(unsafe)` statics + NSLocks onto task-local scopes. Part of #2204.

## Changes
- `legacyBaseURL`: remove the static + its `NSLock` + setter; the reader returns `nil` when the task-local
  isn't set (the existing `withLegacyBaseURLOverrideForTesting` scope is the sole override path).
- Display intervals: add `@TaskLocal` stores + `withDisplay…IntervalOverrideForTesting` scopes (new
  `CookieHeaderCache+TestingOverrides.swift` extension), readers now read `taskLocal ?? default`, and remove
  the statics + `displayIntervalOverrideLock` + setters.
- Move the ~32 test call sites to the scoped `with…{ }` form.
- **Supersedes #2205**: replaces `displayIntervalOverrideLock` with task-local isolation (eliminate-shared-state
  over locking) and removes the now-obsolete `DisplayIntervalOverrideConcurrencyTests` (an opt-in TSan stress of
  that lock — the process-global race it exercised no longer exists).

## Validation
- `make check` → 0 violations / 1465 files.
- Full suite, contract config (`GROUP_SIZE=4 TIMEOUT=120 RETRY=0`): **659 selections / 165 groups, first-pass
  165/165, 0 failed, 0 retries, 0 timeouts** (477s). CookieHeaderCache suite: 41/41.
- Behavior-neutral: overrides were never written outside `…ForTesting` seams; task-local scoping eliminates
  the race rather than locking it.

## Related
- Part of https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/2204 · follows #2239, #2240, #2242 · supersedes #2205's display-interval lock.

## Out of scope
- Remaining #2204 seam (`KeychainAccessGate`) — separate PR. No account/auth-file behavior changes. Screenshots not applicable (non-UI).

## Notes
- No CHANGELOG entry — internal test synchronization only.


## Real-behavior proof

Fresh build from this PR head (`a67ede9`), then the migrated overlapping-scope concurrency test run under **ThreadSanitizer** — direct evidence that overlapping task-local scopes retain independent values (the property #2205's `NSLock` guarded, now eliminated rather than serialized). Swift 6.3.3, arm64 macOS.

**Zero remaining callers of the removed setters** (repo-wide):

```
$ grep -rn "setDisplayStalenessIntervalOverrideForTesting\|setDisplayUnavailableRetryIntervalOverrideForTesting\|setLegacyBaseURLOverrideForTesting" Sources Tests
(no matches — 0 call sites)
```

**ThreadSanitizer — `legacy URL override supports concurrent teardown reads`** (5 000 concurrent `DispatchQueue.concurrentPerform` iterations entering *overlapping* `withLegacyBaseURLOverrideForTesting` scopes with differing values incl. `nil`, then asserting the outer scope still reads its own value):

```
$ swift test --sanitize=thread --filter "concurrent teardown reads"
Build complete! (88.22s)
◇ Test "legacy URL override supports concurrent teardown reads" started.
✔ Test "legacy URL override supports concurrent teardown reads" passed after 0.018 seconds.
✔ Suite CookieHeaderCacheTests passed after 0.018 seconds.
✔ Test run with 1 test in 1 suite passed after 0.018 seconds.
```

ThreadSanitizer reported **0 data races**. Confirms the task-local scoping is race-free under real concurrent execution, not merely lock-serialized — so removing #2205's `displayIntervalOverrideLock` is safe.

target.title: Doubao: query Coding/Agent Plan usage via arkcli CLI
target.body:
## Summary

- Replace the Volcengine AK/SK signed API with `arkcli usage plan` CLI (SSO-based) for fetching Coding Plan and Agent Plan usage
- Split Doubao menu card into "Coding Plan" and "Agent Plan" sections with group headers
- Replace placeholder smiley icon with official Volcengine logo SVG

## Why

The signed Volcengine API (`GetCodingPlanUsage` / `GetAgentPlanUsage`) required users to obtain AK/SK credentials separately and did not work well. The `arkcli` CLI uses the same SSO session the user already has, making setup trivial - just install arkcli and `arkcli auth login`.

## Changes

- `DoubaoUsageFetcher`: new `fetchCodingPlanUsage(runArkcli:)` runs `arkcli usage plan` and decodes the JSON response. Old Volcengine signer code removed.
- `DoubaoAPIFetchStrategy`: try arkcli CLI first, fall back to Ark API key rate-limit probe.
- `MenuCardView`: split Doubao metrics into two groups (Coding Plan / Agent Plan) with section headers. Other providers unaffected (`guard provider == .doubao`).
- `ProviderIcon-doubao.svg`: official Volcengine logo (MIT-licensed, from thesvg.org).
- Tests updated to match new arkcli JSON format and strategy interface.

Closes #1724.

target.title: Add weekly session-equivalent headroom
target.body:
## Summary

- estimate remaining weekly quota as full 5-hour windows from the median burn across the latest seven completed active session windows
- show the estimate verdict first, then the numeric headroom line, only after at least three reliable samples
- support Codex, Claude, Antigravity/Gemini, and generic providers with unambiguous session/weekly pairs
- respect weekly work-day settings, isolate provider/account/window history, and memoize the existing history scan
- localize the new pluralized output and accessibility labels across all 23 catalogs

Addresses #2261. The issue remains open for reporter confirmation.

## Verification

- `swift test --filter SessionEquivalentForecastTests` — 23 tests passed
- `swift test --filter 'SessionEquivalentForecastTests|UsageStorePlanUtilizationTests'` — 101 tests passed
- source-blind behavior contract — 19 feature cases passed
- `make check` — SwiftFormat, SwiftLint, localization, docs, scripts, and repository gates passed
- all 23 stringsdict catalogs passed `plutil -lint`
- full sharded suite on the feature head before the final isolation hardening — 700 selections passed; exact-head CI is the final full-suite gate
- repeated branch autoreview; all accepted findings fixed, including named-window isolation and preservation of generic weekly reset/history behavior

## Presentation

Verdict leads; numeric estimate follows. The reporter has not answered the ordering question yet, so this uses the owner-approved default.
